description: Interface definition for the Cosmology Engine
purpose: Manages primordial darkness, Dark Star collapse into the Divine Core, and the foundation of all cosmic structures

outputs.name: cosmic_state
outputs.description: The current state of the cosmos including Dark Star and Divine Core creation chain, wolf balance state, and realm configuration

outputs.name: realm_definitions
outputs.description: Definitions for all nine canonical realms

methods.name: initialize_cosmos
methods.description: Set up the primordial state and trigger the creation event

methods.name: get_realm_definitions
methods.description: Return the definitions for all nine realms

methods.name: get_wolf_state
methods.description: Return the current state of White Wolf and Dark Wolf companion balance or coherence pressure

invariants: Nine realms are fixed and canonical
White Wolf and Dark Wolf emerge with Divine Core creation as paired companions of consciousness
Divine Core is the origin center of all reality
Realms and planes are equivalent terms in YWE canon
Wolves may lose coherence temporarily but cannot die permanently
